title: The Most Important Rooms to Have an Air Purifier in
desc: Are you looking to have an air purifier installed in your home? Call our team of experts at Rosenberg Indoor Comfort today to learn more!

blocks.text: Having fresh and clean air to breathe while you’re in your home is important. Whether you’re living in a city where air pollution is a problem or near a busy street that has a lot of traffic, you could benefit from an air purifier. Air pollution tends to build up in indoor spaces and can be exceptionally bad in the winter when you can’t open windows to let fresh air in. Strategically placed air filters can remove harmful particulates and volatile organic compounds from the air you’re breathing inside.

Putting air purifiers in specific locations can maximize the effect they have on the air quality throughout your home. Since bedrooms are used nightly for extended periods of time, they are a great option for a purifier. Other areas that receive high levels of use, such as kitchens or living rooms, are also good candidates for their own air purifiers. Homes that have an open floor plan can often be cleaned with a single air purifier. Multiple units can help ensure clean air throughout a house.

For some situations, a whole-house air purifier can be an energy- and cost-efficient choice. These systems use the ductwork in a house to deliver clean and fresh air throughout a home. They are great for larger homes without an open floor plan.
